# The Dream Casa

> Interior design studio led by Founder Poorti Jain, with studios in Indore (Yeshwant Niwas Rd) and Ahmedabad (Bodakdev, SG Highway), India. Delivers 3D photorealistic architectural renders and 100% turnkey site execution for residential and commercial interiors.

- [Services](https://thedreamcasa.in/services): Full residential interior design and turnkey execution service scope.
- [Modular Kitchen Design](https://thedreamcasa.in/modular-kitchen-designer-indore): Modular kitchen layouts, hardware, and pricing inputs for Indore & Ahmedabad.
- [Commercial & Office Interiors](https://thedreamcasa.in/commercial-office-interior-designer-indore): Office, retail, and commercial fit-out services.
- [Process](https://thedreamcasa.in/process): 6-step turnkey execution methodology from site audit to handover.
- [About](https://thedreamcasa.in/about): Founder Poorti Jain and studio background.
- [Journal](https://thedreamcasa.in/blog): Cost guides and design articles, including Indore interior design pricing by BHK.
